entities.summary: Friedrich von Arenstorff was a German born officer in Swedish and Danish military service. He played a crucial role in the Battle of Lund and was commander-in-chief of the Danish army between February and August 1678 and again in 1688-1689. He also played an important role in the Griffenfeld scandal in 1676.
